name: WARNING: Airport Terminal 'High Fiber' Energy Bars (Inulin / Chicory Root Hazard)
brandOrRestaurant: Fiber One / Think / Quest / Terminal Warning
whyItWorks: Marketed as healthy travel snacks, these bars pack 10g–15g of isolated chicory root fiber (inulin). In a pressurized airplane cabin, rapid fermentation of inulin produces massive, agonizing gas distension and flatulence.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Check labels at Hudson News for 'chicory root fiber' or 'inulin' and strictly avoid them before boarding.
